question: Who was the first to mention the incident of Jauhar in Persian?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Amir Khusrau.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amir Khusrau **was the first to mention the **incident of Jauhar** in the **Persian language.**
 
• He was a famous **poet, musician, and scholar** in the court of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
• Jauhar was a practice in which women of a besieged fort committed **mass suicide** to avoid being captured by the enemy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ibn Battuta** was a **Moroccan traveler and scholar **who visited India during the reign of Muhammad bin Tughlaq. 

 
 
• Ibn Battuta observed that the land's soil was very fruitful, enabling farmers to cultivate the two crops of **Rabi and Kharif **each year.
 
 
 
• The most well-known piece by** Ziauddin Barani** is **"Tarikh-i-Firuz Shahi."**
 
 
• He placed a strong emphasis on using primary **materials and historical authenticity.**
 
 
 
• **Hasan Nizami **was also a famous historian of the Delhi Sultanate.
 
 
• After moving to Delhi, India, from Nishapur, he wrote** Tajul-Ma'asir**, the Delhi Sultanate's first official history.
